title: Roadmap

FastAPI — Zero to Backend Engineer Roadmap

Think of this as our master checklist. We will tick these off one by one.

PART 0 — Backend & FastAPI Mental Model

0.1 What is an API?

  • What an API actually does

  • Client vs server

  • Request → processing → response

  • REST API concept

  • HTTP and JSON

0.2 What is FastAPI?

  • What FastAPI is

  • Why FastAPI exists

  • FastAPI vs Flask

  • FastAPI vs Django

  • When to use FastAPI

0.3 FastAPI Architecture

  • FastAPI

  • Starlette

  • Pydantic

  • ASGI

  • Uvicorn

0.4 WSGI vs ASGI

  • What WSGI is

  • What ASGI is

  • Synchronous vs asynchronous

  • Concurrency

  • Why FastAPI uses ASGI

  • Where Uvicorn fits

0.5 Complete Request Flow

We will visualize:

text
Client
   ↓
HTTP Request
   ↓
Uvicorn
   ↓
FastAPI
   ↓
Middleware
   ↓
Router
   ↓
Path Operation
   ↓
Validation
   ↓
Business Logic
   ↓
Database / Storage
   ↓
Response Model
   ↓
JSON Response
   ↓
Client

Goal: You should eventually be able to explain this entire flow without looking at notes.

One important rule for our sessions

I won't assume you know something just because the crash course skipped it.

For example, if we reach:

python
async def get_user(
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):

I won't say "you already know this" and move on.

We'll break it down:

text
async def
   ↓
function
   ↓
parameter
   ↓
type annotation
   ↓
default value
   ↓
Depends()
   ↓
dependency function
   ↓
database session

until the entire line makes sense.

And whenever I notice that the original notes jump over something important, I'll explicitly mark it as:

⚠️ GAP IN CRASH COURSE — WE ARE ADDING THIS

That way, your checklist stays faithful to the source while becoming a much more complete FastAPI/backend-engineering course.

This master checklist is now our roadmap. We won't skip ahead or silently skip topics.
